invariant: A symbol represented as an empty group leaf has the same painted frontier as that USymbol, rather than the raw layout box.
causal_divergence: Final origin traversal applies symbol frontiers only to nonempty clusters. Empty group nodes beyond the ordinary entity slots default to zero minima and raw maxima; node overscan and UEmpty, and cloud paths are omitted.
planned_change: Resolve empty group layout slots through package render roles and reuse the same symbol frontier functions for final origin, chrome and canvas. Preserve layout serialization and dimensions.
